test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain number of advocates are sitting in a row in a bar council, facing north. Piyush is an immediate neighbour of both Vinod and Taman, while Rudir is an immediate neighbour of both Taman and Biswas. Vinod is sitting at the extreme right end. There are only two advocates to the left of Biswas. If no other advocate is sitting in the row, what is the total number of advocates seated in that row?
solution: According to the given information: 1) Vinod is sitting at the extreme right end. 2) Piyush is an immediate neighbour of both Vinod and Taman, while Rudir is an immediate neighbour of both Taman and Biswas.
